title: 10 CFR Part 50, Domestic Licensing of Production and Utilization Facilities
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Six technical sections and a formula workbook preserve CFR-level workload and totals.
score_rationale.provenance: Dates, CFRs, fee rule and experience identified; time and storage coefficients less independently grounded.
score_rationale.segmentation: Applications, reactor types, records, inspections and standards have meaningful separate rows.
score_rationale.labor: NRC fee rate of $300 is used for private and federal labor without occupational mapping; section2 cites2023 fee rule whereas overview cites2020.
score_rationale.item13: Storage equals .0004 of recordkeeping labor cost; proxy coefficient has no accessible derivation.
score_rationale.item14: Technical workload by section times fee rate; resource mix and overhead components hidden in fee proxy.
score_rationale.item15: Section-level previous/current bridges and CFR driver explanations, including a418894-hour transfer; not every input interaction isolated.
score_rationale.validation: Stakeholder challenge and NRC responses preserved, including opposing estimates and one added requirement.
score_rationale.consistency: Main and workbook totals agree within whole-hour rounding; some section deltas differ by one hour.

labor.basis: 10CFR170.20 average professional staff-hour fee; section2 cites88FR39120 June15,2023

item15.detail: Technical sections2–7, Reasons for Changes; workbook sheet3 rows54–56.

assumptions: New reactor application forecasts use pre-application engagement.
Storage-to-labor factor assumes stable pages and storage technology.
Maintenance record time reduced4315 to3000 hours using staff experience.

reconstruction_issues: Fee rate is not independently established as respondent occupational compensation.
Storage proxy has no pages, price per page or digital-system basis.
ACU proposed200 rather than3580 hours for financial qualifications and12000 rather than7000 for FSAR; NRC rejected both using broader experience, without publishing underlying observations.
methods_worth_testing: Preserve adverse stakeholder burden estimates and agency disposition.
